text.en:
Act Numbered Two thousand and sixty-nine, entitled "An Act making appropriations for sundry
expenses of the provincial governments of Agusan, Nueva Vizcaya, and the Mountain Province, for Insular
expenses in the said provinces and the Moro Province for the period ending June thirtieth, nineteen hundred
and twelve, and adding to the purposes for which the money appropriated by section five of Act Numbered
Two thousand and sixty-two may be used," is hereby amended by inserting the following as section four and
changing the present section four to five:
"Section 4. Subject to approval of the head of the proper Department, provincial boards or chiefs of Bureaus
or Offices may expend on permanent improvements funds appropriated for current expenses."

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, December 20, 1911.
